newsitem.title: NORWAY: Aker Maritime wins Oseberg gas platform dea.
newsitem.headline: Aker Maritime wins Oseberg gas platform dea.

text.p: Norwegian offshore services group Aker Maritime ASA said on Thursday it had been awarded a 1.6 billion crown contract to build the topside of the North Sea Oseberg gas platform by operator Norsk Hydro ASA.

The contract is for the planning, procurement, fabrication and completion of the 7,200-tonne topside, which includes the gas flare and a bridge linking the installation with the Oseberg A platform at the field centre.
Aker Engineering, Aker Elektro and Aker Verdal will work together on the project, which will begin immediately, Aker Maritime said in a statement.
Fabrication of the structure is scheduled to begin in mid-July, with delivery due in April, 1999.
